```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r sourcing, include=FALSE}
#source the R folder to load any packages and functions
lapply(dir('R', '*.R', full.names = TRUE), source)

#read in finalized data
dat <- readRDS("Output/Data/final_data.rds")

#get median density?
med_density <- dat[, median(density)]

#categorize density based on median
dat[density >= med_density, density_cat := "high"]
dat[density < med_density, density_cat := "low"]

#make control only data set
control <- dat[grid == "SU" | grid == "KL"]

#make food treatment data set
food <- dat[food == 0 | food == 1]  #just food add and control grids

#make rattle experiment data set
rattleyears <- dat[food == 19, unique(year)] #get years with rattles
rattle <- dat[year %in% rattleyears & !grid == "AG"] #take all data from year of rattle playbacks but Agnes


```


## Preliminary Analysis

Below is the basic relationship between growth rate, litter size, and density.

```{r fig1, include = TRUE}

#this model is Growth Rate ~ Litter Size x Local Density Category
bmod <- lm(growthrate ~ littersize*density_cat, control)
anova(bmod)

#get effects table
base_effs <- as.data.table(ggpredict(bmod, terms = c("littersize", "density_cat")))

#plot regressions on top of raw data
ggplot()+
  geom_point(aes(x = littersize, y = growthrate, color = density_cat), alpha = 0.2, data = control)+
  geom_ribbon(aes(x = x, ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high, group = group, fill = group), alpha = 0.2, data = base_effs)+
  geom_line(aes(y = predicted, x = x, color = group, group = group), linewidth = 1, data = base_effs)+
  scale_color_discrete(name = "Density")+
  scale_fill_discrete(name = "Density")+
  labs(x = "Litter size", y = "Growth rate (g/day)", subtitle = "SU and KL only")+
  theme_bw()

```


Next, same thing but using the food data set. Add in food treatment as factor.

```{r fig2, include = TRUE}

#this model is Growth Rate ~ Litter Size x Density Category x Food Treatment
fmod <- lm(growthrate ~ littersize*density_cat*treatment_food, food)
anova(fmod)

#get effects table
food_effs <- as.data.table(ggpredict(fmod, terms = c("littersize", "density_cat", "treatment_food")))

#plot regressions on top of raw data
ggplot(food_effs)+
  geom_point(aes(x = littersize, y = growthrate, color = density_cat), alpha = 0.2, data = food)+
  geom_ribbon(aes(x = x, ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high, group = group, fill = group), alpha = 0.2)+
  geom_line(aes(y = predicted, x = x, color = group, group = group), linewidth = 1)+
  scale_color_discrete(name = "Density")+
  scale_fill_discrete(name = "Density")+
  labs(x = "Litter size", y = "Growth rate (g/day)", subtitle = "Grid Treatment")+
  facet_wrap(~facet)+
  theme_bw()

```

Lastly, same thing but for the rattle data set. Incorporate rattle treatment.


```{r fig 3, include = TRUE}
# make model for growth ~ litter size * density category * rattle treatment
rmod <- lm(growthrate ~ littersize*density_cat*treatment, rattle)

#summary
anova(rmod)

#get effects table for model
rat_effs <- as.data.table(ggpredict(rmod, terms = c("littersize", "density_cat", "treatment")))

#plot regressions over raw data
ggplot(rat_effs)+
  geom_point(aes(x = littersize, y = growthrate, color = density_cat), alpha = 0.2, data = rattle)+
  geom_ribbon(aes(x = x, ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high, group = group, fill = group), alpha = 0.2)+
  geom_line(aes(y = predicted, x = x, color = group, group = group), linewidth = 1)+
  scale_color_discrete(name = "Density")+
  scale_fill_discrete(name = "Density")+
  labs(x = "Litter size", y = "Growth rate (g/day)", subtitle = "Grid Treatment + Bucket")+
  facet_wrap(~facet)+
  theme_bw()
  
```
